text.en:
The effectivity of Republic Act No. 6361, otherwise known as the Price Control Law, is hereby
extended up to June 30, 1979, and the amount allotted for personnel services is increased from One Hundred
Thousand (P100,000.00) Pesos for a full year to Three Hundred Thousand (P300,000.00) Pesos. The
additional amount necessary for the operation of the Council up to 1979 is hereby appropriated out of any
funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated.

Any provision of law, decree, executive order or regulation inconsistent herewith is hereby
repealed, amended or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 23rd day of June in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
